airport_records.name: Cancún International (1986)
airport_records.location_note: Republic scan7 explicitly identifies CUN as Cancun. Quintana Roo government dates handover of the international airport installations to1975; the earlier city airstrip is not used. Later terminals/runways are not reconstructed. Coordinates are a current approximate airfield marker, not a surveyed1986 terminal, runway threshold or reference point. Modern ICAO codes locate coordinate records; source-era airport identity reviewed separately.
